thread:
Elliot: Heads up, Dottie (the office conure) unlocked the snack drawer and is now courageously sampling espresso beans. pic: https://i.imgur.com/dottie.jpg
Samira: Wait WHAT. Espresso beans? :scream:
Gabe: Dottie the Door-opener, Keymaster of Snacks. :parrot:
Elliot: She tapped the drawer, it popped, she hopped in, and then sat like she owned the place.
Samira: Is she ok?? Beans are... not great for birds. @office-bot facilities?
office-bot: Alert: please do not allow animals access to caffeinated foods. Facilities notified.
Gabe: I carefully lured her out with a single almond. She accepted, then demanded a tiny contract. (photo attached)
Samira: Can we have a "No beans" sign on the pantry? Also petition to give her a tiny nameplate.
Elliot: Poll: Dottie merch? nameplate / tiny hard hat / mini ID badge
Gabe: badge
Samira: nameplate
Elliot: hard hat (for safety reasons)
plants-bot: Reminder: keep pantry plants out of reach of pets. Consider bird-safe herb pot near window.
Elliot: Update: Dottie has been safely relocated to her perch and the beans have been disposed of. She gave me three indignant chirps.
Gabe: Also she now knows how to open the whiteboard cabinet. Security? :eyes:
Samira: Official motion: add Dottie to the "pet privileges" roster and ban coffee beans from common areas. Thumbs? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
Elliot: +1 :thumbsup:
Gabe: +1 :thumbsup:
office-bot: Noted. Facilities will add signage and review pantry protocols. Reminder: do not attempt to train pets with caffeinated items.
Samira: Closing photo: Dottie wearing a post-rescue tiny scarf. (gif) Peace restored. :sparkling_heart:
